text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌0.76%，深成指跌1.49%，贵金属、锂矿、煤炭、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4300只
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 2%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.76%, and the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.49%, with precious metals, lithium mining, coal, semiconductors and other sectors leading the declines; more than 4,300 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
